description: This file serves as the entry point for the React-based Tizen Recipe App frontend. It initializes the React application, renders the main App component within a StrictMode wrapper, and attaches it to the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the component tree.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree starting with the StrictMode and App components.
